name: @w6w-apps/gumroad
description: Manage Gumroad products, sales, subscribers, licenses, offer codes and payouts, and subscribe to sale webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Gumroad is where creators sell digital products, courses, memberships and coffee-tip pages without running a store. This app gives a workflow the seller's side of that: read and edit the product catalogue, pull sales and refund, revoke or restore a buyer's access, list memberships and their subscribers, and manage the license keys that gate your software.

It also covers the merchandising levers around a product — variant categories and variants, offer codes, and checkout custom fields — plus the account-level refund policy, payouts, and the annual earnings summary.

For event-driven flows, resource subscriptions register a URL that Gumroad POSTs to on a sale, refund, dispute, cancellation or subscription change, so a workflow reacts instead of polling.
